findings.title: Float-based layout in .small-action breaks once it becomes a flex container
findings.body: .small-action is now a flexbox container (@include flexbox()), but its children still rely on floats: .topic-avatar has float: left and the button has float: right. Floats are ignored on flex items, so the action button that previously sat at the far right of the row will now render inline immediately after .small-action-desc instead of being right-aligned. The .small-action-desc also lost its 'padding-left: 4em' which previously cleared the 45px-wide avatar; combined with the removed 'margin-top: 5px' and 'padding-top: 4px' this changes vertical alignment of the description text. Either convert the children to proper flex layout (e.g. margin-left: auto on the button) or keep the floats and don't make the container a flexbox.

findings.title: align-items mixin emits invalid value for legacy -webkit-box syntax when 'baseline' is used
findings.body: The new align-items mixin passes the value straight through to -webkit-box-align and -ms-flex-align. The old 2009 flexbox syntax (-webkit-box-align) only accepts start/end/center/baseline/stretch — actually 'baseline' is not valid for -webkit-box-align in old WebKit (it accepts start, end, center, stretch only). .badge-wrapper.bullet calls @include align-items(baseline), so on browsers using the legacy -webkit-box syntax the alignment declaration is invalid and dropped, silently changing rendering there. If legacy support matters (which the prefixes imply), the mixin should map values per-syntax.

findings.title: Dead .valign-helper rule left behind after flexbox conversion
findings.body: The .contents block was converted from float/inline-block vertical-centering to flexbox with align-items: center, which makes the .valign-helper element (an inline-block 100%-height shim used to vertically center siblings) unnecessary. The rule remains in the stylesheet; if the corresponding span is also still emitted in the markup it will now participate as an extra zero-width flex item. The leftover markup/CSS should be removed as part of this change.
